Passive Effect: Stone trigger range and damage range expand, dealing 250% ATK as Arts damage Active Effect: Stops attacking but Attack Range expands ; grants 8 stones, then any stones above the limit are placed within Attack Range, prioritizing tiles with enemies ; when manually placing stones within Attack Range, stones can be placed on tiles with enemies and Talent 1 deploys up to 3 additional stones at the cost of an equal amount of ammo Skill activation grants 20 ammo, skill ends when manually deactivated or stones are depleted, any ammo remaining is refunded as stones

stages.effectText: Can use traps with a lower DP cost [ note 1 ] to assist in combat, but traps cannot be placed on tiles already occupied by an enemy; trap Deployment Limit increases [ note 2 ]
When a stone is activated, for every stone in the same straight chain, all stones within that chain deal an additional 12% damage and ignore 11 RES (stacks up to 3 times)
When a stone is activated, for every stone in the same straight chain, all stones within that chain deal an additional 13% damage and ignore 12 RES (stacks up to 3 times)
